newsitem.title: USA: Bank of New York files $500 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Bank of New York files $500 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Bank of New York Co Inc said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $500 million in debentures and preferred securities.

The registration also included preferred securities that will be offered by five business trusts formed by Bank of New York, known as BNY Capital I, BNY Capital II, BNY Capital III, BNY Capital IV and BNY Capital V, the filing said.

The proceeds from the offering of the preferred securities will be used to buy junior subordinated debentures of Bank of New York. Then, in turn, Bank of New York will use it for general corporate purposes, the company said.
